messages:
lucy: Heads-up — scheduling a config-only canary at 23:00 UTC for routing + batching tweaks. Not changing model binary, just serving params.

lucy: Planned changes
```yaml
route_policy: weighted
routing.weights.default: 0.15 -> 0.25
batching.max_batch_size: 64 -> 96
batching.batch_timeout_ms: 500 -> 400
observability.alerts.5xx_threshold: 1%
```

lucy: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 30m -> evaluate p95 latency, 5xx rate, kvcache memory pressure, kv_miss_rate. If healthy ramp to 25% for 1h then full.

miguel: ack. I'll wire a dashboard pulse and keep an eye on warmup noise.

sophie: Can we tenant-exclude the internal-load tests? last time they skewed batching numbers.

lucy: good call. adding tenant_exclude: ["internal-load", "perf-staging"] to canary.

ben: +1. Suggest a quick rollback hook: automatic rollback if 5xx increases by >0.8% sustained for 5m OR p95 increases >120ms over baseline for 5m.

lucy: adding rollback policy to the deploy config. Also adding a telemetry tag so we can slice by model/version.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy started: config-only canary (id: 1768880007) by lucy — targeting service: inference-prod, canary traffic: 5% -> route_weight change + batching params. See /deploys/1768880007

deploy-bot: rollout step: canary applied to 5% at 23:00:12 UTC.

tara: oncall here — watch kvcache memory and eviction rate. Increasing batch size historically spikes kv cache retention. I'll be ready to step in. :eyes:

miguel: dashboard link: https://grafana.company/reports/1768880007 (p95, 5xx, kv_mem, kv_miss). Setting a 1m refresh.

lucy: note to self: disable autotuner for this window (we want stable kernel selection).

ben: quick rollback command for ops: `/deploybot rollback 1768880007` — that will unapply config and revert routing weights. Keep that handy.

sophie: pin request: keep tenant "enterprise-proxy" on old config for the first hour (they have latency-sensitive traffic).

lucy: acknowledged — applying tenant pin for enterprise-proxy.

deploy-bot: Canary health check @ +10m: p95 38ms -> baseline 36ms (ok), 5xx rate 0.06% (below threshold), kv_mem +2% (within noise). No automatic rollback triggered.

miguel: looks clean at +10. I'll mark as passing canary if it stays under thresholds for another 20m.

lucy: proceeding to ramp to 25% after 30m hold per plan. Watchlist: p95, evictions/sec, kv_miss_rate.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% applied at 23:35:48 UTC.

tara: small uptick in evictions at 23:40 — up 9% from baseline but not yet critical. Monitoring.

ben: flagging a note in release checklist: if evictions >20% or kv_miss_rate doubles, immediate rollback.

lucy: adding that to the release notes. Draft: "config-only: routing weight increased to reduce tail latency for small prompts; batching max size increased to improve cost efficiency; batch timeout lowered to reduce p95 for medium requests. Monitoring kvcache metrics post-rollout."

sophie: thanks — can we add "tenant: enterprise-proxy pinned to old config for 1h" to notes?

lucy: done.

deploy-bot: Final status @ +60m: canary stable, no rollback. Recommendation: continue to 100% over next maintenance window or wait for customer signoff.

miguel: recommending another 2h observation before full prod push given eviction trend.

tara: agree, leaving on 25% for 2h. I'll escalate if evictions cross 15%.

lucy: fine by me. locking this thread — we'll reconvene if thresholds trip. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
